_comment: Peacock pack switches read by kubejs/server_scripts/*.js. Server-side; takes effect on /reload or restart. ladder=false disables recipe staging and place/hire gates (Blueprints still drop). sleepPercent: players (%) that must sleep to skip the night (-1 = vanilla rule untouched). afkMinutes: minutes without moving before a name greys out in the tab list (0 = off).
